note: Syllabus rows that a lab EXISTS for but that must NOT count as built, because the lab covers only part of what the row lists. tools/prayog_claim.py enforces this: a revoked row is never counted, even if a later claim names it.

revoked.phase-shift-oscillator: row says 'with a BJT'; the lab draws an op-amp amplifier
revoked.logic-gates: row lists NAND and NOR realisations; the lab is NAND only
revoked.sonometer-frequency: row lists an electrically maintained tuning fork AND AC mains; the lab covers mains only
revoked.neutron-activation: the lab measures the product half-life only, not the neutron flux the row is about
revoked.langmuir-probe: row lists an argon RF discharge; the lab models only the DC glow
revoked.sc-tc-four-probe: row lists YBCO, niobium film and lead; the family models niobium-type and lead-type only (no YBCO-type, ~92 K)
revoked.sc-critical-current: row lists a YBCO bridge and NbTi wire; the family models NbTi-type only
revoked.quantum-hall: row lists GaAs/AlGaAs AND graphene; the lab models the GaAs-type 2DEG only
revoked.shubnikov-de-haas: row lists GaAs, bismuth and graphene, and asks for effective mass and quantum lifetime; the lab extracts carrier density from GaAs-type only
revoked.esr-research: row lists DPPH, Mn2+ in MgO and an irradiated radical; the lab models DPPH only
revoked.mossbauer-fe57: row lists alpha-iron, stainless steel, hematite and nitroprusside; the lab models alpha-iron and hematite only
revoked.xrd-rietveld: the lab is a lattice-parameter and scale-factor refinement on a fixed structure, not a Rietveld refinement; atomic positions, a listed unknown, are not refined
revoked.xrr-thin-film: thickness is measured, but roughness, a listed unknown, is only in the model and is not measured
